Class ConversationsResource

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.interfaces.web.ConversationsResource
@Path("/ui/conversations") @Produces("text/html") public class ConversationsResource extends Object
The conversation fragments for index.html: the history list, the main pane for one conversation, sending a message and moving the session. Requests that start background work wait for its outcome (see SessionWaiter), because the page has no live channel. Those waits can last minutes, so every handler runs on a virtual thread instead of holding one of the shared worker threads.

The server keeps no page state. Which conversation is open is a cookie, so a reload comes back to it.
